1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, frondoso, de flores blancas, que da una legumbre plana; su madera es de gran dureza y se usa para fabricar vigas. Fabaceae; Myrospermum frutescens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 20 m, with dense foliage and white flowers, producing a flat legume; its wood is extremely hard and used for making beams. Fabaceae; Myrospermum frutescens.
